Package com.shaft.coverage.journey

package com.shaft.coverage.journey
Journey and interactive-state coverage (issue #5455).

Stable identities for journeys, views, interactions, and UI states are recorded from execution evidence only. Coverage maps compare those observations to a declared catalog or baseline, and report unknown/unobservable targets separately from uncovered ones.
